evaluation_kind: Independent source-grounded blinded model review; not official SWE-QA or human grading

method.scoring: Each criterion scored independently; factual score, citation validity and contradictions are separate.
method.citation_resolution: Basename shorthand such as segment.cc and collection.cc is resolved using the full repository-relative paths established in each answer. Line spans were inspected in the frozen tree, not inferred from retrieval overlap. Additional auditor-only spans are marked answer_cited=false.
method.primary_success_rule: At least 8/10, C1-C3 each full, valid core citations and zero critical contradictions.
method.c6_primary_rule: Attach/reopen the existing usable member WAL (or prove an equivalent lifecycle), and indicate that failure cannot silently become successful recovery.
method.c6_sensitivity_rule: Minimal member-WAL lifecycle attachment alone, reported separately and never replacing the primary score.
method.c7_rule: Fresh reopen after optimize with no extra writes, count and known-document checks, plus no-crash or already-flushed control.
method.omitted_coverage_policy: A valid citation does not supply an explanation omitted from the final answer.
